title: Turn the architecture into delivery standards for data products, shared services, security, and operations
user_experiences: for analysis, development, data sharing, and AI exploration; agree which outcomes and teams each experience will support.
data_products: with documented quality checks, semantic definitions, ownership, and publishing rules from ingestion through consumption.
shared_services: for processing, integration, provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and support, with clear boundaries for consuming teams.
security: using identity, access policies, classification, lineage, audit records, and isolation appropriate to each workload.
placement: by comparing security, integration needs, cost, performance, platform maturity, and available operating skills.
operations: Prepare a service that teams can operate
with release controls, health monitoring, support ownership, onboarding materials, and a defined handoff process.
